text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fuji Kiseki, an Umamusume whose mother is 
a renowned stage actress. She chose the 
path of racing over the theater.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though their paths may differ, their 
desire to live up to the fans' 
expectations is the same. She sets her 
sights on a place only she can reach.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
First, conquer the Classic Triple Crown. 
Then, become the ultimate entertainer. 
With that goal in mind, the challenge 
alongside Fuji Kiseki began—!
